symptom: ako/mxcli#1652 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1643): `textfilter tfName (Attributes: [Name], Placeholder: 'Search name', Adjustable: false)` in `create page` passed check (no MDL-WIDGET06/07) and exec, and neither value was stored — describe printed a bare `textfilter tfName (Attributes: [Name])`, 'Search name' occurred 0 times in the page BSON. `alter page … set (placeholder: …, adjustable: …) on tfName` wrote both. Feeding describe's own `adjustable: false, placeholder: '…'` back into create stored adjustable and still dropped placeholder
cause: The filters' hand-written definitions map neither key, so both reach the widget engine's explicit-property pass (Build step 4.6), which looked the authored name up in the template's PropertyTypeIDs byte-for-byte. `Adjustable` != `adjustable`; and `Placeholder:` is a grammar keyword (PLACEHOLDER) that the visitor always stores as Properties["Placeholder"], so no spelling could reach the template's `placeholder`. check's allow-list, its persistedByExplicitPass verdict, the mapping pass (lookupProperty) and ALTER's setter (#1069) all fold case — the create writer was the one reader that did not
file: mdl/executor/widget_engine.go (explicitPropertyKey, used by the explicit-property pass in Build)
fix: Resolve the authored name to the template's own key case-insensitively (exact match first; a case-only match must be unique and of a kind the pass writes correctly — the explicitPassWritableTypes set check already calls persisted), and write/scope by that key. Authored names are iterated sorted, since two spellings can now land on one key
test: mdl/executor/widget_explicit_key_case_test.go — real embedded text/number/date filter templates; asserts the stored placeholder TextTemplate text and adjustable/delay PrimitiveValue. Stashing the fix fails 5 subtests with `placeholder stored "", want "Search name"` / `adjustable stored "true", want "false"` / `delay stored "500", want "250"`. Repro mdl-examples/bug-tests/textfilter-1652-placeholder-adjustable.mdl
insight: Siblings came free: the number and date filters declare the same `placeholder`/`adjustable` pair and the text/number `delay`, and the fix is in the shared pass, so every unmapped key on every pluggable widget now behaves the same in any case. When the checker judges keys case-insensitively and calls a key 'persisted by the explicit pass', grep the WRITER's lookup for a bare map index (`propertyTypeIDs[name]`) — that one line was the whole disagreement, and it is the same bug #1069 fixed on the ALTER side a release earlier. A grammar keyword is a spelling the author cannot control: the visitor canonicalises `placeholder:` to `Placeholder`, so describe's lower-case output could never round-trip — test the describe spelling, not just the report's. Structural proof that is cheaper than a browser: the placeholder WidgetValue written by create is identical (ids stripped) to the one ALTER writes, which the reporter showed working; raw mx check 11.13.0 on the repro is 0 errors. Not fixed here, seen on the same repro: check -p warns MDL-WIDGET10 that a text filter's `attributes` 'is hidden when attrChoice is auto — the value will be ignored', but SetAttributeObjects flips attrChoice to 'linked' and the attributes ARE written (a false warning, the #1519 dropdownfilter shape on the text/number/date defs)
